title: Reject wrapped RSE identifiers and verify each legacy omission
scope: Prevent GP5 RSE integer records from silently wrapping into zero or unrelated int16 values, and verify that every non-default legacy RSE descendant independently triggers the existing scoped GP8 loss policy. Preserve the explicit proprietary-effect target boundary.
acceptance: Check every int32-to-int16 conversion in readRseInstrument before assigning Instrument, Unknown, SoundBank, and GP5.1 EffectNumber. Preserve signed int16 values including -1; reject values below -32768 or above 32767. Cover -32769, 32768 and 65536 independently. GP5.0 EffectNumber remains the signed-16 source case and must retain its record alignment. Exercise -32768 and 32767 as exact passing endpoint controls at each narrowing site.

Use a valid GP5 source fixture with a located RSE field for a public Parse regression. Add focused reader tests covering every narrowing site and truncated records; malformed data returns contextual errors and cannot produce a silently zeroed RseInstrument.

For each public RSE leaf independently, start with a score that produces no unrelated loss: master EQ knobs, EQ gain, volume, reverb; track instrument EffectCategory, Effect, Instrument, Unknown, SoundBank, EffectNumber; track EQ knobs, EQ gain, Humanize, each nonzero AutoAccentuation; and UseRse. Assert the correct parent omission code and score/track location, strict no-byte failure, exact-code allowlist success, and unchanged public input. Zero scalar and absent/empty-slice controls must not fabricate losses. A present Knobs=[0] has authored slice shape and must retain its existing omission report; it is not an absent EQ.

Record the existing target limit: pinned GPIF RSE parsing/writing retains ordinary balance and volume only, while binary RSE bank fields are skipped. Keep gp8.omit.master-rse, gp8.omit.track-rse and gp8.omit.track-use-rse. TrackSound, MIDI effects and volume-automation contracts stay separately owned.

Record targeted regressions and exact source/report evidence in the semantic ledger and work item. Run ./conformance/check.sh and prek run --all-files. Do not promote unsupported GP8 semantics from a checked-decoding or omission-policy fix.
exclusions: No proprietary synthesizer/effect equivalence, audio comparison, archive-blob retention, oracle upgrade, or sound-bank mapping.
The unnamed RSE integer remains opaque signed data; do not invent an enum or restrict valid negative values solely from examples.

reproduction.instructions: The embedded reader probe writes int32 value 65536 into each of four GP5.1 RSE record fields in turn. Run with a temporary Go overlay on conformance_playback_test.go: go test -overlay OVERLAY.json -count=1 -v -run ^TestInvestigationRSEWideValues$ . . All four currently return zero-valued RseInstrument with nil error. Use the existing RSE.gp5 corpus file as a starting point for a complete public Parse regression; locate the intended source record rather than assuming byte offsets.
